invariants.rationale: If font.usesIntegerPositions() is true, result must be an integer value due to (int)textY cast before return; else result can be any float.
When background is not null, result is increased by at least background.getBottomHeight().
font is a required parameter and used unguarded; so it is never null at method exit.
Regardless of path, textY is calculated based on font.getDescent(), which is always added.
If result is not positive, it reflects that font.getDescent() may be negative enough to cause non-positive textY.
